turns.text: Write a Python script that simulates a 1D random walk of 1000 steps and save a histogram of the final positions of 500 walkers as a PNG.
What is the standard deviation you would expect for the final positions? Answer in two sentences.
Link the histogram you made earlier and say whether its width matches that expectation.

notes: Synthetic grounding case (SOURCE-LEDGER-PLAN.md section 7); no user data.
